notes: white noise over the whole 16 kHz track, SNR on the whole-track power, draws keyed by seed:track:condition
MP3: mono constant bitrate via libsndfile/LAME at the source rate (22.05 kHz sources via 44.1 kHz), peak-normalized before encoding, then resampled to 16 kHz
augmentation: one draw per track (kind uniform, parameter uniform), evaluation seed and augmentation seed differ
